---
title: "Dirichlet Multinomial Modeling"
author: "Giacomo Antonello"
format: html
params:
  outdir: "results/DirichletMultinomial"
  k_communities: 10
  n_workers: 10
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(mia)
library(DirichletMultinomial)
library(furrr)
library(openxlsx2)

seed <- 1234
set.seed(seed)
theme_set(theme_light(base_size = 14))
dir.create(params$outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# model 1 to k_communities communities
num_communities <- seq_len(params$k_communities)

load("../NHANES_oral_microbiome.se.rda")
```

```{r filter by prevalence and detection, warning=FALSE}
# make a minor filtration for very rare taxa: at least 10 counts in 50 of samples
critical_prev <- 50/ncol(NHANES_oral_microbiome.se)
NHANES_oral_microbiome_filtered.se <- subsetByPrevalent(NHANES_oral_microbiome.se, assay.type = "counts", detection = 10, prevalence = critical_prev)
```

```{r calculate dirichlet multinomial mixtures, warning=FALSE}
plan(multisession, workers = params$n_workers)
# fitting time grows with k, so submit the largest k first and give each k its
# own future (scheduling = Inf): a free worker always picks up the next k,
# instead of furrr's default of pre-splitting k into one fixed chunk per worker
# pass the seed explicitly, otherwise each worker draws a random one
DMN_results.list <- future_map(
  rev(num_communities),
  function(k) mia::calculateDMN(NHANES_oral_microbiome_filtered.se, k = k, assay.type = "counts", seed = seed)[[1]],
  .options = furrr_options(scheduling = Inf)
) %>%
  rev()
names(DMN_results.list) <- paste("k", num_communities, sep = "_")
```

```{r}
fits <- data.frame(
  k = factor(rep(num_communities, 3)),
  method = rep(c("AIC", "BIC", "Laplace"), each = length(num_communities)),
  goodness_of_fit = c(
    sapply(DMN_results.list, AIC),
    sapply(DMN_results.list, BIC),
    sapply(DMN_results.list, laplace)
  )
)

bestfit_plot <- ggplot(fits, aes(x = k, y = goodness_of_fit, color = method, group = method)) + 
  geom_line(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual") + 
  labs(
    x = "Number of communities modeled (k)",
    y = ""
  ) + theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
  
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mixtureWeights.list <- lapply(DMN_results.list, mixturewt)

mixtures.list <- lapply(DMN_results.list, mixture) %>% 
  lapply(function(x){
    colnames(x) <- sprintf("CST.%s_assign_prob", seq_len(ncol(x)))
    return(x)
  })

assignments_CST.df <- future_map(mixtures.list, function(y) apply(y, 1, function(x) {
  
  CST <- which.max(x)
  CST_prob <- max(x)
  # 
  x[which.max(x)] <- 0
  
  second_best <- which.max(x)
  second_best_prob <- max(x)
  
  CST <- paste("CST", ifelse(CST_prob - second_best_prob < 0.2, "Other", CST), sep = ".")
  CST_prob <- ifelse(CST_prob - second_best_prob < 0.2, NA_real_, CST_prob)
  return(data.frame(CST, CST_prob))
}) %>% 
  lapply(as.data.frame) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "SEQN"))


mixtures_final.list <- list()

for(k in num_communities){
  mixtureK <- mixtures.list[[k]] %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column("SEQN")
  
  CST.df <- assignments_CST.df[[k]] %>% select(-CST_prob)
  
  mixtures_final.list[[k]] <- dplyr::left_join(CST.df, mixtureK, by = "SEQN")
}

names(mixtures_final.list) <- names(assignments_CST.df)
```

# Write results

```{r write results}
for(k in num_communities){
  data_to_write.list <- list(
    Mixture = mixtures_final.list[[k]],
    MixtureWeights = mixtureWeights.list[[k]]
  )
  
  write_xlsx(data_to_write.list, file = file.path(params$outdir, sprintf("CST_assignments_for_k%s.xlsx", k)))
}

ggsave(plot = bestfit_plot, filename = file.path(params$outdir, "BestFitPlot.svg"), height = 5, width = 6)
```
